study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter randomized trial
cohort: 1942 women with preterm premature rupture of membranes (pPROM) from a multicenter randomized trial of magnesium sulfate versus placebo to prevent cerebral palsy or death among offspring of women with anticipated delivery at 24-31-week gestation
finding: Maternal obesity is a risk factor for chorioamnionitis prior to labor onset in women with pPROM.
